title: Fix MeetingDetailsScreen markPresence snackbar repetition via listenWhen
objective: Prevent the 'Presença atualizada com sucesso!' snackbar from re-firing every time MeetingDetailsCubit emits a new MeetingDetailsLoaded state (e.g. when loadPresences() rebuilds the state with copyWith), by guarding the listener with a listenWhen that only allows the transition from MarkingPresenceStatus.loading → .success (or .error).
description: MeetingDetailsScreen (lib/ui/meetings/meetingDetails/widgets/meeting_details_screen.dart, lines 40-63) wraps the screen in a BlocConsumer whose listener fires AppSnackbar.success / AppSnackbar.error / context.pop() / AppSnackbar.error based on which sub-field changed. Today the listener fires on EVERY state change (no listenWhen), so once the user taps the 'Confirm presence' FAB: (1) state transitions to MarkingPresenceStatus.loading → snackbar listener body runs, finds success == false, no-op; (2) state transitions to MarkingPresenceStatus.success → snackbar fires once; (3) markPresence internally calls loadPresences() which emits a NEW MeetingDetailsLoaded with presences updated — the listener fires AGAIN because markingPresenceStatus is still .success, so 'Presença atualizada com sucesso!' snackbar fires a second time. The fix adds a listenWhen that returns true only on a transition of markingPresenceStatus OR deleteStatus — not on every copyWith. The recommended pattern is to track the previous status in a closure variable OR (cleaner) to compare state.markingPresenceStatus against a previousState.markingPresenceStatus captured at the top of the listener.

reference_files.reason: The BlocConsumer whose listener fires the snackbars. REPLACE with a version that uses listenWhen.
Source for MeetingDetailsLoaded, MarkingPresenceStatus, DeleteStatus — read-only context for the listener logic.

fix_shape.preferred_with_listenWhen: Wrap the BlocConsumer in `listenWhen: (previous, current) { if (current is! MeetingDetailsLoaded) return false; if (previous is! MeetingDetailsLoaded) return current.markingPresenceStatus != MarkingPresenceStatus.initial || current.deleteStatus != DeleteStatus.initial; return previous.markingPresenceStatus != current.markingPresenceStatus || previous.deleteStatus != current.deleteStatus; }`. The listener body stays exactly as it is (lines 41-62).
fix_shape.alternative_with_closure_capture: Hold a `MarkingPresenceStatus? _lastMarkingStatus` and `DeleteStatus? _lastDeleteStatus` in the StatefulWidget (convert _MeetingDetailsScreenState from StatelessWidget to StatefulWidget if needed) and only fire snackbars when those change.

acceptance_criteria: The BlocConsumer now specifies a listenWhen callback (either on the consumer directly or via a StatefulWidget conversion)
Tapping the 'Confirm presence' FAB triggers exactly ONE 'Presença atualizada com sucesso!' snackbar — even though loadPresences() emits a follow-up MeetingDetailsLoaded with presences updated
Tapping the 'Deny presence' FAB still triggers the same snackbar behavior (success or error message reflects the cubit's result)
When markPresence fails, the error snackbar fires exactly once
When deleteMeeting succeeds, context.pop() fires exactly once — not repeatedly
The success snackbar still fires after the cubit transitions loading → success (no regression on the initial transition)
flutter analyze lib/ui/meetings/meetingDetails/ returns no errors

grep_evidence: rg -n 'listenWhen' lib/ui/meetings/meetingDetails/widgets/meeting_details_screen.dart must return at least one match
If the StatefulWidget conversion is chosen: `rg -n '_lastMarkingStatus|_lastDeleteStatus' lib/ui/meetings/meetingDetails/widgets/meeting_details_screen.dart` must return at least two matches.
validation.behavioral_test: Manual: open a meeting detail screen, tap 'Confirm presence' 3 times — the success snackbar appears 3 times (once per tap), not 6 times (twice per tap). Repeat for deleteMeeting — context.pop fires once.

no_op_outside_scope: Do not change MeetingDetailsCubit logic. Do not change AppSnackbar. Do not change any other screen's listener pattern (the bug is specific to this state shape — other BlocConsumers in the app do not have the copyWith-fires-listener problem because their state classes are sealed with discrete types).
